items.titulo: Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls
items.resumen: Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for noisy, high-stakes phone calls. It is in enterprise research preview, with no published benchmarks, size or pricing yet. The post Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy
items.resumen: Cmpnd released dspy-wsp, a prototype DSPy optimizer for weight-space programming. A frontier LLM reads a small model’s weights, edits them in a sandbox, and tests each change, with no gradients and about $5 to $10 per run. The post Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy appeared first on MarkTechPost .

Release: datasette-llm 0.1a11 datasette-llm is the intermediate plugin for Datasette that supports configuring LLMs for use with other Datasette plugins. This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere that talks the OpenAI pseudo-standard web protocol. This means that if you're running local models with LM Studio or Ollama or llama.cpp (which just hit v1.0.0 ) you can run Datasette via uvx like this: wget https://datasette.

Release: datasette-vega 0.7 A new release of Datasette's longest untouched plugin, for rendering charts (using Vega-Lite ) against data in a table or custom query. The last release was in July 2018! I finally bumped it for compatibility with the latest Datasette alphas, plus some cosmetic tweaks to make it work better with Datasette Lite .
